lines.text: Jake took his dog Rocky on an eight-mile hike.
Rocky's longest walk before that was two miles.
At mile five, Rocky lay down and wouldn't move.
Here's the fix. Ask your vet first, then build up slowly, adding a little distance each week.
Carry water just for your dog, and check paws at every break.
Turn back early if your dog lags or pants hard.
A month later, they finished together.
Save this before your next dog hike.
